content.title: About
content.content: A diet carbonated beverage with chocolate cola flavor combines the classic cola taste with a subtle hint of cocoa, while containing no sugar. It is designed for those who want a sweet flavor without extra calories.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Chocolate cola flavor first appeared in the early 2000s as a limited‑edition experiment.
Diet colas typically use artificial sweeteners such as aspartame or sucralose.
Caffeine content in diet colas is usually 30–40 mg per 330 ml, comparable to regular cola.
The chocolate note is achieved with natural or artificial cocoa flavorings.
The drink is often marketed as “sugar‑free but flavorful” in advertising campaigns.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: Absence of sugar reduces the calorie count to about 1–2 kcal per 100 ml, making it suitable for weight control.

items.title: Caffeine content
items.content: Caffeine can increase alertness and improve concentration, though the amount is moderate.

items.title: Sugar‑free
items.content: Lack of glucose and fructose is beneficial for people with diabetes, provided they are not sensitive to artificial sweeteners.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Like any carbonated drink, it contributes to daily fluid intake.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Some versions are fortified with B3 and B6 vitamins, which support energy metabolism.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Aspartame and sucralose may cause individual reactions such as headaches in sensitive persons.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Acidic components can contribute to tooth enamel erosion with frequent consumption.

items.title: Caffeine
items.content: Excessive intake may lead to insomnia, increased heart rate, and anxiety.

items.title: Allergens
items.content: Some flavorings may contain trace allergens, e.g., dairy.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: Caffeine can amplify the effects of certain stimulants and reduce the efficacy of sedatives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve chilled, in moderate amounts. Pairs well with light snacks, sugar‑free desserts, and in mocktails based on non‑alcoholic mixers.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 3–5 days.
